text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
And the winner of the Satsuki Sho, the
very first
race of the Classic Triple
Crown, is...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Pant... pant...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
What happened in that race? And what
is this
feeling?
(Urk!)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
(I still feel so overwhelmed by the
intensity in her
voice!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: GAAAHHH! UNGH!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I'll win the next one even if it kills me!
Don't you
dare think you've seen the last
of me!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Is it possible for her to get better—more
than she
already has?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
If she does, then next time I face off
against her,
I'll surely—

Biwa Hayahide returns to the waiting
room with a
dark expression on her face.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Yes. I'm fine.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
This is all because I let myself become
arrogant...
Or maybe it means there's a
flaw in my equation.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I just need to figure out what my mistake
was.
There must be a solution to it.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
This was the result of a simple
miscalculation.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
As long as I fix it, the equation should
produce the appropriate results, and I
won't have to worry about
losing ever
again...

Her voice keeps getting smaller and
smaller until
she's nearly inaudible.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Woohoo! Yeaaah!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Next up is the Derby! And I'm taking the
crown
home!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna win no matter what! You hear me?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna be the Derby Champion!
Yeaaah!
Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
She certainly is excited...
I can't believe
we can
hear her all the way in here.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: But I have to admit... she is good.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Oh, sorry! Let's reanalyze things right
away.
There's not much time left until
the Derby, so we
can't waste any time...

The next stop on our journey together is
the
second race of the Classic Triple
Crown tour—the
Japanese Derby.

But hearing such urgency in her voice
makes me
worry that something in her is
beginning to crack.
